registration.detail: Registered on init whenever Fair Audience is active.

minimal.title: Newsletter signup
minimal.description: Name and email with double opt-in, no category choice.

syntheticIds.categoryIds: Post category term IDs to offer (Posts → Categories).
syntheticIds.preselectedCategoryIds: A subset of categoryIds checked by default.

with-weekly-feeds.title: Signup with a weekly update
with-weekly-feeds.description: Offers the weekly update, unchecked, and lets subscribers choose event feeds.

with-hidden-feed.title: Signup for one event feed's weekly update
with-hidden-feed.description: Shows the weekly update checked and subscribes to one configured event feed without listing feeds.

syntheticIds.feedId: An event feed ID with an enabled weekly email (Fair Events → Event feeds).
